verses.pali: “Bhojanaṁ, bhikkhave, dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṁ pañca ṭhānāni deti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when a giver gives food, they give the recipients five things.

verses.pali: Āyuṁ deti, vaṇṇaṁ deti, sukhaṁ deti, balaṁ deti, paṭibhānaṁ deti.
verses.english: Long life, beauty, happiness, strength, and eloquence.

verses.pali: Āyuṁ kho pana datvā āyussa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā;
verses.english: Giving long life, they have long life as a god or human.

verses.pali: vaṇṇaṁ datvā vaṇṇassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā;
verses.english: Giving beauty, they have beauty as a god or human.

verses.pali: sukhaṁ datvā sukhassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā;
verses.english: Giving happiness, they have happiness as a god or human.

verses.pali: balaṁ datvā balassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā;
verses.english: Giving strength, they have strength as a god or human.

verses.pali: paṭibhānaṁ datvā paṭibhānassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
verses.english: Giving eloquence, they are eloquent as a god or human.

verses.pali: Bhojanaṁ, bhikkhave, dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṁ imāni pañca ṭhānāni detīti.
verses.english: When a giver gives food, they give the recipients five things.
Being attentive, one is a giver of life, strength,
